paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 scores for different methods. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis and include "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking." The vertical axis indicates the NDCG@10 values, with a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 and tick intervals at 0.05. Each bar represents a method's score, with "Ours" depicted in orange at approximately 0.21, while the other methods, "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking," are shown in blue, with estimated values of about 0.18, 0.07, and 0.12, respectively. Bars are visually differentiated by color and are ordered alphabetically. The bar for "Ours" being the tallest is visually distinguished by its orange color, and "-scoring" has the lowest height, and except for "Ours", all other categories share a common blue hue. No specific sorting order is indicated beyond the alphabetical arrangement.
